name: Mi van than
summary: Mi van than is Hanoi’s wonton noodle soup, finished with chives, shiitake, pork rind, and a large fried dumpling.
origin: Hanoi. The city’s dish list sets this bowl apart from southern wonton noodles by those toppings.
texture: The fried dumpling is the extra crunch on the bowl.
howToEat: The Hanoi bowl comes with chives, shiitake mushrooms, pork rind, and a large piece of fried dumpling.
where: Alley 16, Hai Bà Trưng, Hoàn Kiếm.
seoTitle: Mi van than — Hanoi wonton noodles
seoDescription: Mi van than in Hanoi is wonton noodles with chives, shiitake, pork rind, and a fried dumpling. The dish list points to alley 16, Hai Bà Trưng.
